name: Moebius 0.22B
notes: ECCV 2026; MIT license; 226M params; 15x faster than FLUX.1-Fill-Dev (11.9B); 26ms/step on single GPU. Also covers build_outpaint, build_magic_eraser, build_lama_remove. ONNX available (simonw/Moebius-ONNX). Tier 1.

name: Qwen-Image-Edit 20B
notes: Alibaba Tongyi; open-sourced 2026-06-25. Qwen2.5-VL condition encoder + VAE Encoder for appearance. Semantic, appearance, and bilingual text editing. 20B may need int8 quant on 16GB RTX 5060 Ti. Direct architectural target for build_qwen_edit. Tier 1.

name: Krea 2 Turbo
notes: Open weights 2026-06-22. 12B dense DiT; Qwen3-VL encoder + Qwen Image VAE. 8-step distilled (~2s/2K img). FP8 fits 16GB. Proprietary community license (commercial free <$1M revenue). Requires ComfyUI >= 0.26.0. New builder needed. Tier 2.

name: Krea 2 Raw
notes: Open weights 2026-06-22. Unrestrained base variant of Krea 2; optimised for fine-tuning and diverse outputs. Same Qwen3-VL + Qwen VAE architecture as Turbo. Tier 2.

name: Boogu-Image (base/edit/turbo) + TextEncodeBooguEdit node
notes: Native in ComfyUI 0.26.0 (2026-06-23). Qwen3-VL-8B + FLUX.1 VAE; double-stream MMDiT. TextEncodeBooguEdit supports negative prompts + reference images. Bilingual. Sibling architecture to build_qwen_edit; could extend or complement. Tier 2.

name: HyperSwap 1a_256.onnx (speed)
notes: FaceFusion 3.3.0 face swap ONNX at 256x256 (2x vs inswapper_128). Speed variant. Accessible via ComfyUI-ReActor >= 0.6.x (2026-05-12). Models go in ComfyUI/models/hyperswap/. Additive — inswapper_128 unchanged. Also affects build_faceswap_model, build_faceswap_mtb. Tier 2.

name: HyperSwap 1c_256.onnx (quality)
notes: FaceFusion 3.3.0. Maximum realism variant. ReActor >= 0.6.x. Tier 2.

name: LTX-Video-0.9.8-13B-distilled
notes: Released 2025-07-17; ComfyUI-LTXVideo node updated 2026-05. 13B distilled (6x vs 2B). Supports 60s video. ICLoRAs for pose/canny/depth/detail at v0.9.8 (165K downloads on detailer). Tier 2 checkpoint upgrade.

name: LTX-Video-ICLoRA-detailer-13b-0.9.8
notes: 2025-07-16. 165K downloads. Detail-enhancing ICLoRA for LTX 0.9.8 13B. Companion: pose (0.9.7), canny (0.9.7), depth (0.9.7) ICLoRAs also available. Tier 2.

name: ComfyUI-SeedVR2 1-Click v1.8b
notes: 2026-06-14. New 1-Click GUI; FP8/GGUF; BlockSwap for 8GB VRAM. SeedVR2.5 backbone (ICLR 2026). Full release promised by maintainer — may arrive this week. Also affects build_seedv2r. Pin check needed. Tier 2.

name: Wan 2.7 (14B MoE)
notes: April 2026. Apache 2.0. 14B MoE; T2V, I2V, reference-to-video, instruction editing. ComfyUI partner node active. ModelScope weights; HF mirror arriving. VRAM FLAG: 24GB+ without GGUF — exceeds 16GB RTX 5060 Ti budget. Also affects build_wan22_t2v, build_wan_flf, build_wan_animate_video, build_wan_video_blockswap, build_wan_video_blockswap_t2v. Tier 3 (VRAM blocker).

name: SAM 3.1 + native ComfyUI nodes
notes: March 2026. Meta SAM 3.1 adds shared-memory multi-object multiplex tracking; faster than SAM3. Native ComfyUI nodes: SAM3_Detect, SAM3_VideoTrack, SAM3_TrackToMask, SAM3_TrackPreview. Checkpoint: sam3.1_multiplex_fp16. Also affects build_sam3_mask, build_sam3_extract, build_magic_eraser, build_klein_sam3_inpaint. Tier 3.

name: InfiniDepth (CVPR 2026)
notes: Inference code March 2026; training code April 2026. Arbitrary-res (up to 16K) monocular depth via neural implicit fields. Produces metric depth, normal maps, and 3DGS from single RGB. No dedicated ComfyUI node confirmed yet. Also affects build_normal_map. Tier 3 (no node yet).

name: NTIRE 2026 Face Restoration Challenge Winners
notes: April 2026 challenge; 10 teams; AdaFace-style identity conditioning. No public checkpoint yet — watch for team code/model drops. Also affects build_photo_restore. Tier 3.
